structureCanonicalizer: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(structure, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); outcomes, candidate bytes, receipts and this root field are excluded.

structure.objective: Preserve the exact active suffix dropped by Desktop rewind or gateway /retry as inactive non-compacted rows, retain explicit hard-rewrite callers, and expose bounded read-only recovery.

normalizer.algorithm: Inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, canonicalize both expected_history and the active persisted rows as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators. Preserve ordered rows and the persisted semantic fields role, content, tool_call_id, tool_calls, tool_name, effect_disposition, token_count, finish_reason, reasoning, reasoning_content, reasoning_details, codex_reasoning_items, codex_message_items, platform_message_id/message_id alias, observed, api_content, display_kind and display_metadata. Canonicalize JSON-valued fields recursively; map absent and database NULL to one null representation; do not sanitize, strip or flatten content. Exclude the database-only/scoping fields row id, session_id, active, compacted and timestamp; no other semantic field is excluded. Any unsupported/non-serializable value or byte mismatch is a conflict, never a lossy coercion.
normalizer.mismatch: Raise RewindHistoryConflict before any UPDATE; caller maps it to stale rewind/no resend.

interfaces.transaction: One SessionDB._execute_write BEGIN IMMEDIATE closure performs compression-closed guard, active-row SELECT, normalizer compare, target-user resolution, suffix UPDATE, active message/tool counter recomputation, rewind_count increment and new-head SELECT. No validation or target lookup occurs outside the write transaction.
interfaces.compressionGuard: Before comparison or mutation, apply the same ended_at/end_reason=compression guard as replace_messages and raise CompressionSessionClosedError.
interfaces.result: Return rewound_count, target_message, new_head_id and active counters from the committed transaction. Retained prefix and pre-existing inactive rows are not deleted or reinserted.

interfaces.contract: Existing r2 identity and opening-turn confirmation resolve against the current in-memory history; pass that full expected history plus target user ordinal to I1. Mutate session.history/history_version, set running and launch a turn only after I1 commits. RewindHistoryConflict maps to 4018; CompressionSessionClosedError or storage failure returns a persistence error with no memory/DB/turn side effect.

interfaces.semantics: Wrap I1 and clear dirty transcript state only as part of successful rewind semantics. /retry checks the result and must not zero token state or resend on False/exception. rewrite_transcript remains deliberately destructive for redaction and rotated-compression/new-session callers.

Default remains active-only. include_rewound=True returns active rows plus active=0,compacted=0 rewind rows in insertion order with content and row-state fields, excluding compacted=1 archives. It is read-only.
Read-only, one resolved session, JSONL only. Reject --only, logical lineage, --delete-after-verified, upload, trace and bulk/filter combinations. Default exports are unchanged.

interfaces.contract: has_platform_message_id(session_id, platform_message_id) considers active=1 OR compacted=1 rows, not active=0 AND compacted=0 rewind rows.
interfaces.semantics: Preserves transient-failure and compaction dedupe while preventing a rewound row with a real platform id from suppressing a later legitimate live persistence. Explicit resurrection contract: after a row carrying platform id X is rewound to active=0,compacted=0, has_platform_message_id(X) returns False; re-delivery of X inserts one new active live row while the exact old row remains inactive. If any active=1 or compacted=1 row carries X, lookup remains True and the duplicate is suppressed. /retry is explicitly NOT a consumer because its synthetic MessageEvent has message_id=None and short-circuits before lookup.

interfaces.contract: No schema, configuration, dependency or rewind-specific TTL
interfaces.semantics: Rewound rows remain with the session and are deleted only by existing authorized whole-session deletion/pruning.

interfaces.provider: Array-indexed user-facing retry adapters (TUI command.dispatch /retry and CLI /retry)
interfaces.contract: retry_array_index_to_user_ordinal(expected_history, last_user_array_index) -> truncate_before_user_ordinal, then I1 before memory/send/requeue
interfaces.coordinateConversion: Validate 0 <= last_user_array_index < len(expected_history) and expected_history[last_user_array_index].role == 'user'. Compute truncate_before_user_ordinal as the count of role=='user' rows strictly before last_user_array_index. Rebuild user_indices exactly as prompt.submit/_model_user_texts and require user_indices[truncate_before_user_ordinal] == last_user_array_index. Any failed check is a semantic conflict; the direct history-array index must never be passed to I1 as a user ordinal.
interfaces.ordering: Pass the complete pre-truncate expected_history and converted user ordinal to I1. Commit durable rewind first; only then truncate memory, increment history_version and emit send/requeue.

tuiErrorContract.4018: no history, no user turn, empty target, coordinate mismatch, stale/semantic history conflict
tuiErrorContract.5008: canonical DB unavailable/write failure, including CompressionSessionClosedError
tuiErrorContract.failureSideEffects: No history/history_version mutation and no type=send response.

interfaces.cliFailureContract: On missing DB identity, coordinate mismatch or I1 failure, return no retry payload, do not enqueue _pending_input, and leave conversation_history unchanged while printing/logging a stable persistence failure.
